tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Lists every exclusion source and every state license source with its status today: live, not live, or information only. No key needed, free, returns no provider data. Use it before screening to know what a result can and cannot cover. A source that is not listed as live is not checked.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Plans, monthly request quotas, prepaid credit packs and deposit floors, in cents and dollars. No key needed, free, returns no provider data.

tools.name: how_to_get_access
tools.description: How to get a sandbox key (sample data) and a live key, the real URLs, and what each key returns. No key needed, free, returns no provider data.

tools.name: screen_practitioner
tools.description: Screens one practitioner: state license status and board discipline flags (only for states that are live; sandbox keys get SAMPLE data for every state), identity check against CMS NPPES, and exclusion screening (OIG LEIE, SAM.gov and the state Medicaid lists that are live), with an evidence receipt.

tools.name: screen_roster
tools.description: Adds practitioners to the account's roster for monthly monitoring (up to 500 per call). It does NOT return screening results: results arrive with the next monitoring run and are read with get_receipt (roster_id + period). Each entry needs NPI + first name + last name. tools.description: Fetches a signed receipt as JSON: either a practitioner receipt by file name (the .json file name from a screening result, for a practitioner on your roster) or a monthly roster receipt (roster_id + period YYYY-MM, built from your latest complete run). tools.description: The append-only audit ledger of monitoring events for a practitioner on this account's roster (a practitioner screened or rostered by this key). Free (rate limited). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: how_to_get_access, screen_roster · Private data: screen_practitioner, screen_roster, get_receipt, verify_receipt, get_practitioner_history · Public sink: screen_roster · Destructive: screen_roster, get_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: how_to_get_access, screen_roster · Private data: screen_practitioner, screen_roster, get_receipt, verify_receipt, get_practitioner_history · Public sink: screen_roster · Destructive: screen_roster, get_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
